name: Patel Engineering Ltd
title: Patel Engineering Ltd-$ - 531120 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue flat at INR 5,102 crore with 13.4% EBITDA margin; FY27 guided +10% and order target INR 8,000 crore, but tender success was only ~12-13% last year and promoter pledge and asset sales remain the core story.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth ~10%
triggers.quote: we expect FY ’27 revenue to grow by 10%

triggers.label: Lost Dibang-scale bid to new low-price entrant
triggers.quote: somebody took it at a very low value, so we did not get it

triggers.label: Order inflow target INR 8,000 crore
triggers.quote: we expect around INR 8,000 crore new order book during the year

triggers.label: Debt cut to INR 1,187 crore
triggers.quote: the consolidated gross debt as of March 31, 2026, is INR 1,187 crores compared to INR 1,645 crores

guidance.quote: we expect FY ’27 revenue to grow by 10%
we expect around INR 8,000 crore new order book during the year
we should get between 150 to 200 cash at least

prior_guidance_check.quote: revenue in FY ’26 has crossed INR 5,000 crore and we achieved revenue of INR 5,103 crore

red_flags.label: Promoter pledge reduction without timeline
red_flags.quote: our endeavor is to reduce gradually

red_flags.label: Exceptional items and litigation-linked write-offs
red_flags.quote: we have provided for impairment of investments made in hydro subsidiaries of approximately INR 56 crores

red_flags.label: Arbitration receivables INR 700-3,000 crore stuck in courts
red_flags.quote: overall expected timeline of this will be around five to six years

evasions.quote: at present, we will not be able to give the exact timeline
the number of flats sold details I do not have right now
